message.content: {"predictors":[{"name":"Inventory Volatility Ratio","construction":"Standard deviation of quarterly inventory levels (Compustat item INVT) over the past 12 quarters, scaled by average inventory over the same period.","rationale":"Firms with more volatile inventories may face higher uncertainty and risk, which could be compensated with higher returns.","higher_returns_for":"high values of the measure"},{"name":"Advertising Expense Intensity Change","construction":"Annual change in advertising expenses (Compustat item XAD) divided by lagged total assets (Compustat item AT), measured over the most recent fiscal year.","rationale":"Increasing advertising intensity may signal growth investment not yet priced in by the market.","higher_returns_for":"high values of the measure"},{"name":"Long-Term Debt Growth Acceleration","construction":"Second difference (acceleration) of long-term debt (Compustat item DLTT) over the past three fiscal years, divided by total assets.","rationale":"Accelerating debt issuance may precede significant investment or expansion that the market undervalues.","higher_returns_for":"high values of the measure"},{"name":"Net Working Capital to Market Value","construction":"Net working capital (current assets minus current liabilities, Compustat items ACT - LCT) divided by market capitalization (CRSP).","rationale":"Firms with high working capital relative to market value could be undervalued or more financially flexible.","higher_returns_for":"high values of the measure"},{"name":"Gross Margin Seasonality","construction":"Standard deviation of quarterly gross margin percentage (gross profit / sales, Compustat items GP/Sale) over the past 12 quarters.","rationale":"Firms with less predictable gross margins may be riskier but potentially offer higher returns as compensation.","higher_returns_for":"high values of the measure"},{"name":"Industry Sales Dispersion","construction":"Firm's annual sales (Compustat item SALE) minus the mean sales of its industry (4-digit SIC), divided by industry sales standard deviation.","rationale":"Outlier firms in terms of sales—especially on the high side—might be mispriced due to insufficient peer comparables.","higher_returns_for":"high positive or negative values of the measure"},{"name":"R&D Consistency Score","construction":"Number of consecutive years with nonzero R&D expense (Compustat item XRD) over the past 10 years.","rationale":"Sustained R&D investment could signal long-term innovation, which markets tend to undervalue.","higher_returns_for":"high values of the measure"},{"name":"Unrecognized Asset Growth","construction":"Annual change in off-balance sheet operating leases (from footnote disclosures) divided by total assets.","rationale":"Growing off-balance sheet assets may indicate hidden investments not fully incorporated into equity prices.","higher_returns_for":"high values of the measure"},{"name":"Share Repurchase Frequency","construction":"Number of quarterly reductions in shares outstanding (Compustat item CSHO) over the past 12 quarters.","rationale":"Frequent buybacks may reflect management signaling undervaluation or commitment to shareholder returns.","higher_returns_for":"high values of the measure"},{"name":"Patent Grant Momentum","construction":"Number of new patents granted (from USPTO records matched by firm) in the past 12 months minus the previous 12 months, divided by total assets.","rationale":"Increasing patent activity may precede new product launches and future earnings surprises.","higher_returns_for":"high values of the measure"}]}
